verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Speech-to-Text API with streaming/VAD tuning (grok-docs-4), implying real-time voice capability exists, and a community comment anticipates a 'voice mode' for Grok (grok-comm-13), but there's no first-party description of a full natural voice-conversation feature in the consumer app nor any hands-on confirmation that it works well or is used for knowledge-work tasks. Missing for 10: dedicated voice-conversation product docs, demonstration of natural back-and-forth dialogue, independent/hands-on reviews confirming quality and latency, and knowledge-worker-specific use cases.
